title: Purported AI-Generated Content Circulates Widely in Sudan Amid Civil Conflict and Information Vacuum

behaviors.text: Purported AI-generated deepfakes have circulated widely on Sudanese social media during the ongoing conflict, allegedly spreading false claims, impersonating public figures, and distorting political discourse.
Reported incidents include fabricated videos and audio used to mislead or satirize, some of which gained traction among journalists and officials.
